brief:
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said Hamas has demonstrated sincere solidarity in its actions, according to Al Jazeera English. He criticized Israel for what he characterized as continuing aggressive attacks on Gaza, positioning the Palestinian group's conduct as a genuine response to military operations in the territory.

The statement reflects Turkey's diplomatic stance on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Ankara has maintained channels of communication with Hamas while consistently condemning Israeli military actions in Gaza. Erdogan's comments underscore the Turkish government's support for the Palestinian cause and its criticism of Israeli security operations.
dek: Erdogan said Hamas has shown all possible sincere solidarity, while Israel continues aggressive attacks on Gaza.
title: Erdogan backs Hamas sincerity, condemns Israeli Gaza operations
